answer: Each identity plants a garden plot by locking one marble bond, then passes a sable audit tracing the marble's mint lineage to its funder. The fee doubles per identity from one funder: the k-th fake pays 2^(k-1) marbles, so N clones cost 2^N-1 total. Splitting funds across fresh keys fails, because the check follows the marble, not the key; a shared lineage burns every bond.
